reader.requirement: At --std 85 an OPTIONAL relative file absent at OPEN INPUT, I-O or EXTEND opens successfully with status 05 (I-O and EXTEND create it; a later sequential READ gives 10, a random READ or START gives 23), OPEN OUTPUT is unaffected by the phrase, and an absent non-OPTIONAL file gives 35 on INPUT, I-O and EXTEND.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002): at 85 every OPEN shares AllOther instead of ReadOnly/NoOther; it does not touch the OPTIONAL decision
the same FileSharingFacility behaviour, off at 85

reader.edition-search: grep OPTIONAL/IsOptional over CobolIO.g4, the binder, VersionConformancePass and Runtime/IO: OPTIONAL is parsed and bound with no edition test, and KeyedConnector.OpenCore's present/absent/optional switch has no edition test; grep Edition/DialectBehaviors in Runtime/IO found only the sharing behaviours on the OPEN path.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the OPTIONAL open rules are the same code at 85 and 2023; only the implementor sharing default on the same OPEN differs.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf19_02 covers sequential access INPUT/I-O/EXTEND/OUTPUT and non-OPTIONAL INPUT; not random or dynamic access, random READ or START on an absent optional file, OUTPUT over an existing optional file, or non-OPTIONAL I-O and EXTEND (all probed here).

probes.printed: OD OPEN INPUT 05 / OD RANDOM READ INV 23 / OD START INV 23 / OD AFTER READ NEXT 46 / OR OPEN INPUT 05 / OR READ INV 23 / OR OPEN I-O 05 / OR WRITE 00 / OR REOPEN 00 / OR READ7 00 AAAA / OR PRESENT OPEN INPUT 00
probes.expected: 05 at OPEN of an absent optional file; 23 for a START or random READ on it (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 GRL2.3b.2); I-O creates the file

probes.printed: OP OPEN OUTPUT 00 / OP OPEN OUTPUT AGAIN 00 / OP EMPTY AFTER OUTPUT 10 / USE NI 35 / NI AFTER I-O 35 / USE NE 35 / NE AFTER EXTEND 35
probes.expected: OPTIONAL does not apply to OUTPUT (normal create); a non-OPTIONAL absent file gives 35 on I-O and EXTEND

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.2.3.4 GR3  (2.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.3b.2

reader.notes: The OPTIONAL decision lives in KeyedConnector.OpenCore: absent and not optional gives 35; absent and optional on INPUT gives 05 with no store, on I-O/EXTEND it creates the file and gives 05; OUTPUT ignores the flag. The 46 after an unsuccessful START is what §1985:VIII.1.3.4 (5) e 1 gives. The only edition switch on the path is the 2002 file-sharing default, which does not bear on this rule.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-129/runs/r3a-002 (--std 85), aimed at what the reader did not try: absent OPTIONAL dynamic file OPEN INPUT 05 with a USE procedure declared on it and the USE did NOT run (05 is successful completion, §1985:VIII.1.3.4 (1)c); first READ NEXT 10 (AT END ran), second READ NEXT 46 (USE ran, a logic error not at end); CLOSE 00; re-OPEN INPUT still 05 (INPUT does not create the file); OPEN I-O of an absent OPTIONAL random file with nothing written then CLOSE: a non-OPTIONAL SELECT of the same ASSIGN opens INPUT 00 and reads 10 (the file was created, Table 1 of §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR1); same for OPEN EXTEND then CLOSE (NE 00); OPEN EXTEND of an absent OPTIONAL sequential file with RELATIVE KEY: 05, WRITEs number 1, 2 (key set), re-EXTEND of the present file 00 and WRITE numbers 3; the file reads S1S1 S2S2 S3S3. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.2.3.4 GR3  (2.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.1c' (status 05: 'If the open mode is I-O or extend, the file has been created'); 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR1'. Grep of Runtime/IO for DialectBehavior/Edition: on the OPEN path only FileSharingFacility (the reader's two sites); no OPTIONAL arm by edition.
